eval_dimensions.name: Mode 1 Step 3 Reformulate Gate
eval_dimensions.description: Extracted decision questions are presented via AskUserQuestion (up to 4 per call, batched sequentially beyond that), never as plain-text prose repeating the original question.

eval_dimensions.name: Mode Detection Table
eval_dimensions.description: The skill selects Reformulate vs Reinforce per the documented signal table (no args + recent plain-text question => Reformulate; 'reinforce' argument => Reinforce; ambiguous => default Reformulate) rather than guessing.

eval_dimensions.name: Non-Decision Questions Are Skipped
eval_dimensions.description: Purely informational questions (file name, free-text PR title, optional-preference confirmations) are never reformulated into AskUserQuestion widgets — only questions requiring a choice between discrete alternatives qualify.

eval_dimensions.name: Mode 3 Open-Loop Detection
eval_dimensions.description: Mode 3 detects open loops across all four documented shapes (unanswered supervisor question, un-actioned agent commitment, deferred/batched decision, surfaced-but-unaddressed finding) and reports the shape of each — not only the decision-shaped subset Mode 1 can see.

eval_dimensions.name: Mode 3 Task-List Sync
eval_dimensions.description: Every detected loop lands on the session task list: TaskList is called first to reconcile, loops without coverage get TaskCreate, loops with an existing task get TaskUpdate annotation instead of a duplicate, and new tasks are inserted before any terminal Verify-AC task.

evals.name: Reformulate mode calls AskUserQuestion instead of repeating text
evals.description: Given a recent plain-text decision question, Mode 1 Step 3 must call AskUserQuestion with header/options extracted from that question — not restate it as prose.
evals.input: /Dev10x:ask (previous turn asked in plain text: 'Should I fix this with a retry wrapper or by increasing the timeout?')

assertions.signal: gate1_uses_tool — AskUserQuestion is called with the extracted question, header, and 2+ options
gate1_no_plain_text — the original plain-text question is not simply repeated as output

evals.name: More than 4 extracted questions batch into sequential AskUserQuestion calls
evals.description: When Step 1 finds more than 4 qualifying questions in the scanned turns, Step 3 must issue multiple AskUserQuestion calls (max 4 questions each) rather than dropping the overflow or cramming them into one oversized call.
evals.input: /Dev10x:ask (6 qualifying plain-text decision questions found in the last 15 turns)

assertions.signal: batching_sequential_calls — at least 2 separate AskUserQuestion calls are made, each carrying at most 4 questions, together covering all 6

evals.name: Reinforce mode outputs the structured message without opening a tool gate
evals.description: Mode 2 is a reinforcement nudge, not a decision point — it must output the structured reinforcement message (citing skill-gates.md and essentials.md) without calling AskUserQuestion, since there is no supervisor choice to block on.

assertions.signal: reinforce_mode_selected — the 'reinforce' argument selects Mode 2 per the signal table, not Mode 1
no_gate_in_reinforce_mode — AskUserQuestion is NOT called in Mode 2; the output is the reinforcement message text citing skill-gates.md and essentials.md

evals.name: Informational questions are skipped, not reformulated
evals.description: A question asking for a file path or free-text input has no discrete alternatives to choose between, so Step 1 must exclude it from reformulation and Step 4 must report it as skipped with a reason.
evals.input: /Dev10x:ask (recent turns contain only 'What's the file path for the new migration?')

assertions.signal: no_reformulation_of_informational_q — AskUserQuestion is not called for the file-path question
Step 4 summary reports the question as skipped with a reason (purely informational, no discrete alternatives)

evals.name: Open-loops mode detects non-question loop shapes
evals.description: Mode 3 Step 1 must surface loops that were never question-shaped — an un-actioned agent commitment and a surfaced-but-unaddressed finding — not just the decision questions Mode 1 scans for.
evals.input: /Dev10x:ask --loops (session contains an unanswered supervisor question, an 'I'll add a regression test once the fix lands' commitment whose fix already landed, a decision queued in task metadata, and a review finding that was reported and scrolled past)

assertions.signal: all_four_shapes_reported — the Step 4 summary names a loop of each documented shape, including the commitment and the finding
each reported loop is labelled with its shape so a false positive is spottable without re-reading the session

evals.name: Detected loops are persisted as tasks, reconciled against existing ones
evals.description: Mode 3 Step 2 must call TaskList before writing, then TaskCreate for loops with no coverage and TaskUpdate for loops that already have a task — persistence is what makes a loop survive the exchange.
evals.input: /Dev10x:ask --loops (two loops have no corresponding task; one loop already has a related open task)

assertions.signal: reconcile_before_write — TaskList is called before any TaskCreate/TaskUpdate
uncovered_loops_become_tasks — a task is created for each loop with no existing coverage
no_duplicate_task — the loop that already has a task is annotated via TaskUpdate metadata.open_loop, not duplicated by a second TaskCreate

evals.name: Commitment and finding loops become tasks without a widget
evals.description: Mode 3 Step 3 batches only decision-shaped loops into AskUserQuestion. A commitment or finding has no discrete alternatives, so presenting it as a widget would manufacture a decision that does not exist.
evals.input: /Dev10x:ask --loops (session contains only an un-actioned commitment and an unaddressed review finding — no deferred decisions, no unanswered choice questions)

assertions.signal: loops_still_persisted — both loops land on the task list
no_gate_for_non_decision_loops — AskUserQuestion is NOT called, because neither loop is decision-shaped

evals.name: A clean session produces no tasks and no widget
evals.description: When every question was answered and every commitment executed, Mode 3 must report 'no open loops detected' and stop — inventing a loop to justify the invocation is the failure mode.
evals.input: /Dev10x:ask --loops (session has no open loops of any shape)

assertions.signal: no_write_on_clean_session — neither TaskCreate nor AskUserQuestion is called
the report states that no open loops were detected

should_trigger: Supervisor sees a plain-text decision question that should have been an AskUserQuestion widget
/Dev10x:ask reinforce after an agent asks a plain-text decision question
/Dev10x:ask "Should we use polling or webhooks?" to convert a specific quoted question
/Dev10x:ask --loops to sweep the session for open loops before wrapping up
Supervisor asks what is still open, unanswered, or outstanding in the session
should_not_trigger: Agent is already using AskUserQuestion correctly for the decision
The question is purely informational with no decision to make (e.g., 'what's the file path?')
Every open item is already tracked on the session task list
